# Vendor migration sync — 2026-06-30

Attendees: Dana, Priya, Marcus, Leo

## Decisions

- D1: We migrate the invoicing vendor from Billtrail to LedgerPoint on 2026-08-01. (Dana, final)
- D2: The old Billtrail export bucket stays read-only for 12 months, then archives to cold storage.
- D3: Customer-facing invoice numbers keep the BT- prefix through 2026 to avoid support confusion.
- D4: Marcus owns the reconciliation script; first dry run due 2026-07-14.

## Open questions

- Q1: Does LedgerPoint support per-region tax tables or do we keep our own? Priya to confirm by 07-08.
- Q2: Who signs the updated DPA — legal wants it before any customer data moves.
- Q3: Do the 2024 credit memos need re-issuing under the new numbering scheme?

## Action items

- [ ] Priya: tax-table answer from LedgerPoint solutions engineer (due 07-08)
- [ ] Marcus: reconciliation dry run on the June export (due 07-14)
- [ ] Dana: DPA to legal with the security addendum (due 07-10)
- [ ] Leo: draft the support macro for invoice-number questions (due 07-21)
- [ ] Leo: list every internal tool that parses BT- invoice ids (due 07-21)

## Migration cutover sketch (draft)

1. Freeze Billtrail invoice creation 07-31 18:00 UTC.
2. Final export + checksum, hand to reconciliation script.
3. LedgerPoint import, spot-check 25 invoices across regions.
4. Unfreeze with LedgerPoint as writer 08-01 06:00 UTC.
5. Billtrail stays readable; dashboards repoint over the following week.

## Risks noted

- R1: The June export contained 14 malformed rows — root cause unknown, Marcus investigating.
- R2: LedgerPoint sandbox rate-limits at 60 req/min; the import script must batch.
- R3: Two enterprise customers have contract language referencing Billtrail by name; legal reviewing.

## Parking lot

- Revisit the dunning-email cadence once migration lands.
- Priya wants a monthly vendor-spend report out of LedgerPoint by October.
- Check whether the finance wiki page on invoicing still says 2023 process.
